overrideReason: The automated pipeline's own verifier judged 9/10 criteria genuinely met against attempt 3 (commit 8d3c8f9), with only the live-Helius integration criterion (C9) unproven because HELIUS_API_KEY was not confirmed present or exercised by the gate evidence, opening G5 at 3/3 attempts spent. Rather than re-identify to a new story id (which would not change the underlying question - does the live fetch actually work - only reset the attempt counter), ran the live integration test directly with real credentials. It genuinely failed, three times in a row, on three different, real defects that only running against live Solana/Helius data could have caught: (1) SolanaMessage's extra="forbid" rejected every real v0 transaction because addressTableLookups was never declared as a field, even though every v0 transaction carries one; (2) the original implementation accumulated all ~9,000 of one UTC hour's fully-parsed blocks into memory before counting, exhausting the machine's memory outright on the first live attempt; (3) a single transient transport disconnect among ~9,000 sequential calls aborted 90 minutes of legitimate progress with no retry. A fourth condition (Solana's own normal 'slot was skipped' response, error code -32009) was also found and fixed along the way - not a bug in the sense of wrong behavior, but a case the implementation treated as fatal when it is Solana's documented, expected behavior. All three defects (plus the fourth condition) are fixed in commit bca4b44, verified by a fourth live attempt that PASSED end-to-end: 2h30m33s wall time, a real non-zero active-address count from a real measured UTC hour, no memory exhaustion, no unhandled transient failure. All other 9 criteria re-confirmed fresh against current HEAD.

results.note: tests/test_solana_rpc_fetcher.py — fetcher calls getBlock with no vote-filter parameter (encoding/transactionDetails/maxSupportedTransactionVersion/rewards/commitment only); confirmed by both the offline unit test and the live 2.5-hour fetch completing using only these parameters

is_vote_transaction() classifies a transaction whose only top-level instruction targets Vote111111111111111111111111111111111111111 as a vote, excluded from the fee-payer set — offline test passing, and confirmed structurally sound by the live run producing a plausible non-zero (not all-transactions) count
Inverse case: a non-vote top-level instruction counts its fee-payer — offline test passing

count_active_fee_payers / _count_active_fee_payers_for_hour: exact distinct-signer count for one fixed UTC hour, no averaging or extrapolation anywhere in the implementation — verified by direct code reading of the committed streaming implementation plus the live run's real, non-extrapolated value
source_field states the measured hour window and that it is not a 24-hour count — confirmed by direct code reading of the persistence wiring

HTTP/RPC errors return Error with detail, no value — offline tests passing; the live run's own three earlier failures (schema rejection, memory exhaustion surfacing as a transport error, transient disconnect) each correctly returned Error(FETCH_FAILED) rather than crashing the caller uncaught

extra="forbid" on SolanaGetBlockResponse and its nested models rejects a malformed/reshaped response — offline tests passing; the addressTableLookups fix added a real field rather than loosening this discipline
source_timestamp is the measured hour's own boundary, strictly in the past — offline test passing, confirmed by the live run's real source_timestamp
